messages:
Alex T: Heads-up — planning a soft traffic prime on EU edge: shift routing weights from 10% -> 40% over a 30m window tomorrow 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC. Non-incident, routine. Who can own the deploy and smoke checks?
Marta S: I can own deploy and smoke. will run the routing job and monitor until stable.
Dan R: Can you confirm the fallback model/pool is ready? and rollback steps?
Marta S: yes fallback pool is warmed. rollback is just a weights swap back to current policy + verify health.
Priya N: Preflight checklist (quick):
- ensure CDN health probes green: https://edge-health.internal/eu (should be 200)
- DNS TTL is 60s (we'll lower to 30s 10m before)
- Confirm no ongoing infra changes in EU region
- Run smoke script: `scripts/edge_smoke.sh eu` -> expects `OK` lines
Josh L: pinging @oncall (Dan R) for monitoring/watch. Also please add the canary tag on the rollout job so console shows the change.
Dan R: oncall acked. I'll watch SLO dashboards and tracing for 15m post-prime. set up quick alert: `alerts#edge-error-rate > 0.5% for 3m`
Marta S: putting deploy into scheduled window. lowering DNS TTL now to 30s :wrench:
deploy-bot: Deploy job scheduled by Marta S for 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC — job id `deploy-1896543210`
Marta S: starting rollout: phase 1 -> +15% (current 10% -> 25%). running `routectl set-weight eu-edge policy-alpha 25`
Marta S: smoke check: health endpoint 200, p95 latency 120ms -> p95 baseline 130ms, error-rate 0.12%
Dan R: looks clean from SLOs. traces show no spike in tail latency. :thumbsup:
Marta S: phase 2 -> +15% -> 40% now. `routectl set-weight eu-edge policy-alpha 40`
Priya N: verified DNS propagation — TTL change observed, NX logs show expected cache behavior.
Marta S: full smoke pass: connections healthy, no backend errors, logs show normal traffic mix. rolling metrics attached to job id `deploy-1896543210`
Dan R: standby in case of anomaly. rollback ready command: `routectl set-weight eu-edge policy-alpha 10 && deployctl abort deploy-1896543210`
Josh L: leaving a quick code-review ping on the routing job PR — small config tweak (retries=2). will approve once deploy is stable.
Alex T: great — thanks team. leave monitoring on for 30m then we can close this thread.
Marta S: leaving watch for 30m. will post final status.
Marta S: final: stable after 30m, metrics within expected bounds, no rollbacks required. closing. :white_check_mark:
